findings.title: Slack require_email emailed code did not consult the login policy
findings.exploit: Policy off; attacker controlling a member inbox completes the Slack require_email step with the emailed code.
findings.impact: Passes the Slack verification step only; access policy reads the Slack profile email, so no sharing or owner privilege is granted by the code.
findings.resolution: fixed in branch: member rule + detached send, code from secrets, caller guard extended to send_verification_code

findings.title: Public-link per-address 429 counted only addresses that were sent a code
findings.exploit: Policy off; four /verify/request calls for one address: outsider gets 429 on the 4th, member gets 200.
findings.impact: Reveals platform membership of an address.
findings.resolution: fixed in branch: every request is counted per address while codes are refused
